actions.script: const out = ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.comms.MailSettingsServices.get#RulesView').call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {} : {ruleList: out.ruleList, blockedList: out.blockedList, accountList: out.accountList})

const out = ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.comms.MailSettingsServices.store#Rule').parameters({emailRuleId: emailRuleId || null, ruleName: ruleName || '', emailAccountId: emailAccountId || null, matchAllEnumId: matchAllEnumId || 'ErmAll', conditionsJson: conditionsJson || '[]', actionsJson: actionsJson || '[]', enabled: enabled || null, stopProcessing: stopProcessing || null}).call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {} : {emailRuleId: out.emailRuleId, messageInfos: [{type: 'success', message: ec.l10n.localize('Rule saved')}]})

const out = ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.comms.MailSettingsServices.test#Rule').parameters({emailRuleId: emailRuleId || null, emailAccountId: emailAccountId || null, emailFolderId: emailFolderId || null, conditionsJson: conditionsJson || '[]', matchAllEnumId: matchAllEnumId || 'ErmAll', limit: 50}).call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {} : {matchList: out.matchList || [], matchedCount: out.matchedCount || 0, testedCount: out.testedCount || 0, resultText: out.resultText})

let ids = [] try { ids = JSON.parse(emailRuleIdsJson || '[]') } catch (err) { ids = [] } ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.impl.EmailClientServices.reorder#EmailRules').parameter('emailRuleIdList', Array.isArray(ids) ? ids : []).call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse({})

const out = ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.impl.EmailClientServices.run#EmailRules').parameters({emailFolderId: emailFolderId || '', emailRuleId: emailRuleId || null}).call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {} : {matchedCount: out.matchedCount || 0, actionCount: out.actionCount || 0, ruleErrorList: out.ruleErrorList || []})

const out = ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.impl.EmailClientServices.block#Sender').parameters({emailAddress: emailAddress || '', emailAccountId: emailAccountId || ''}).call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {} : {emailRuleId: out.emailRuleId, messageInfos: [{type: 'success', message: ec.l10n.localize('Blocked: their mail goes to Spam')}]})
